title: Cleaning the Well
sceneText:
Martha says the kitchen water has been cloudy these last two days.

The well is the estate’s own, in the north-east corner of the courtyard. Nobody remembers what year it was last cleaned out.

choices.text: Bring men up from the village to clean it

effects.logEntry: You brought men up from the village to clean out the well.

choices.resultText:
Two men came up from the village and were down there half a day. They brought up a heap of things: rotted staves off a bucket, several stones, one shoe.

“That shoe has been down there some years,” one of them said.

Martha looked at the shoe, said something, and went back to the kitchen.

The next day’s water ran clear.

choices.text: Take men down and do it yourself

effects.logEntry: You spent an afternoon down the well cleaning it out yourself.

choices.resultText:
You took two men down with you.

The bottom of the well is deeper than you thought, and colder. You were down there over an hour, and brought up a heap of things: rotted staves off a bucket, several stones, one shoe.

When you came up Martha was standing at the well head with a bowl of something hot in her hands.

“Drink it,” she said.

You drank it. She watched you finish, took the bowl away, and said nothing else at all.

The next day’s water ran clear.
